title: An MCP server so Claude can see and control Jordan's other Macs through Tether

history.what: held: Asked during the download plan; not part of it. Needs its own plan: screenshots, clicks and typing via Tether's existing input and capture, behind the same Tailscale login check
Planned: the API is P-3 in this repo, and the MCP server and tether command are the new repo mcp-tether (Jordan chose D-A)

body:
Jordan, 2026-10-15: “Is there also an MCP where Claude can connect to Tether to control my other Macs?”
Held: Asked during the download plan; not part of it. Needs its own plan: screenshots, clicks and typing via Tether's existing input and capture, behind the same Tailscale login check
